Lead source: self-serve sign-up (trial credits used) -> inbound demo request.

Key context: B2B SaaS (marketplace for niche SMB tools) adding in-app conversational assistant to reduce support load and improve onboarding. Front-end is React Native webview + desktop web. Primary KPI = perceived latency (start-of-response) and smooth streaming experience. Quote from CTO: "Users drop off if reply start >200ms; need streaming priority for short responses."

What they tested so far: basic chat via API key, quick throughput test (50 concurrent dev users), liked the response quality but saw 300-500ms jitter on long messages in EU region. Concerned about token cost vs current hosted plan.

Security/compliance: wants SSO for admin console, audit logs for token issuance, data retention controls; SOC2 desirable but not mandatory for now.

Tone/behavior in calls: pragmatic, engineering-led, ROI-focused. Not a sales-heavy motion — wants quick POC and clear pricing math.

Notes from AE: Keep messaging tight on streaming SDK + prefix caching. Provide a short checklist for 95th pctl latency testing and a sample React Native streaming snippet. Follow up with POC token bundle (~$1k) and a 2-week performance window.

PRIORITY: High — product roadmap commits assistant to Q3 beta if latency checks pass.
